summary: LaLota voted Yea on H.R. 6090 in May 2024 and sponsored H.R. 1007 in February 2025, each incorporating the IHRA definition of antisemitism and its examples into Title VI education-discrimination enforcement. Those two legislative actions are the basis for the recorded assessment, which identifies candidates who support the IHRA framework as a basis for federal education policy.
